title: Modifying Outlook add-in setup for Nested App Authentication (NAA).

facts.text: Upgrade Business Central to version 25.3, 24.9, or 23.15 depending on current version
Expose API of registered app in Microsoft Entra ID used for authenticating users with Business Central
Create new app registration specifically for connecting Outlook with Business Central
Configure Business Central web server instance to work with Exchange Online
Legacy Exchange Online tokens are deprecated and turned off starting February 2025
